description: It gallops where sleep is thin. Pale flames mark its passing, and by morning no one recalls their dreams.
lore: The pale fire is only at the ends of it — hooves, mane, tail, the parts that move most. The rest is a black horse in good condition with a bright, interested eye that looks straight back at you. It is not remotely quiet about its work, either. Half the accounts begin with somebody sitting up in the grass to watch it go by.

What it costs is one night's dreaming. Everybody within earshot wakes rested and cheerful with a clean gap where the night was, and no way to miss what they cannot remember having had. That is not nothing. A great many of the dead only ever see their people in dreams — the ones who never came, the ones they will not name at a fire because saying it aloud is more than they can manage. A woman on the north circuit had been seeing her mother most nights for two hundred years. She is quite cheerful now.

[[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] has been tracking where it runs for six years, because tracking what the country is quietly losing is what he does. [[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] has a page open for it in [[lore/the_chronicle|the Chronicle]] and it is a short page. He has given her the dates, the ground, the weather and the hour, and not the one thing she keeps asking for, which is which way it goes. Twice she has asked. Twice he has talked about something else until she stopped. She wrote that down too, in the margin, because it is the second thing he will not tell her.
gm_notes: This is the shipped text for beat B16 (hinted): something other than the hole also takes memory. Ship the observation and the unease of the people who measure it — NEVER the connection, never an explanation, never a resolution. Gunnar's withholding is the entire hint and is exactly in character (his dossier: he mistakes carrying a thing alone for keeping people safe); Bettany's marginal note is what makes a careful reader count to two. Kind is 'come', not 'hollowed': the art shows a whole, alert animal with fire only at the extremities, and hollowing is the cave's work — labelling it Hollowed would make the connection for the reader and burn the thread. Description adopted verbatim from the monsters agent; B16's pointer rests on it.
